Interface ReasoningArchitecture

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
BDIArchitecture, BehaviorTreeArchitecture, FSMArchitecture, FuzzyLogicArchitecture, NeuralNetArchitecture, RemoteRLArchitecture, RLArchitecture
public interface ReasoningArchitecture extends Serializable
Base interface for ant behavior reasoning architectures. Implementations include FSM, Neural Network, Fuzzy Logic, and Behavior Trees.
